claim: For games with a sped-up renderer use 'original pace, smooth view': updates keep the original real-time rate and all time saved goes into in-between display views; faster updates and smaller steps were rejected.

evidence.text: Updates keep the original's real-time rate; the freed time renders in-between cameras (display only). Rejected: faster updates, smaller steps.
evidence.quote: the freed time renders in-between cameras (display only). Rejected: faster updates, smaller steps.
